# Babak Transliterate

> Node.js transliteration library for converting between Latin and Persian/Arabic scripts.

A JavaScript/Node.js module providing transliteration functionality for Persian and Arabic text, enabling conversion between Latin keyboard input and native script characters.

## Key Features
- Latin to Persian/Arabic transliteration
- Node.js ES module
- Tested with Node.js built-in test runner
- No external dependencies
